column1: # KiriKiri classic KAG3 text lane replay (synthetic text only, no game content).
# Each case replays the TJS-side events of kirikiri_adapter.inc's KAG text
#   case <name>          start a case with a fresh assembler
#   c <id> <text>        processCh drew <text> (one call per character) on layer <id>
#   s <id> <text>        one processCh call carrying the whole <text> ([ch text=...])
#   w <id>               KAG click wait while layer <id> is current
#   o                    TJS event buffer overflow record
#   flush                encode the pending events into one wire batch and apply it
#   end                  flush, then require that no further line was committed
